== Summary ==
[[Chris Menzel]], organiser of the [[2012 World Championship]] in Bochum, Germany, dressed as Han Solo, with his girlfriend dressed as Princess Leia, during the event.

* '''Source:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=760357#p760357 Post by Shadow 14 (Chris Menzel)], "The props thread", forum.starwarsccg.org, 2012 World Championships forum (16 October 2012), attachment "Sometimes I Even Amaze Myself.JPG", posted under his thanks to his girlfriend: "Love you, honey. (I know!)"
* '''Original image:''' https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=3321 (448×299)
* '''Image preserved copy:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20171229020133/http://www.starwarsccg.org/forums/download/file.php?id=3321 Internet Archive]
* '''Date:''' 13 October 2012 (camera date; Day 2 of the World Championship)
* '''Photographer:''' not stated
* '''Identification:''' Menzel's post (the file name and "I know!" are Han Solo lines); the man matches [[:File:Chris Menzel 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg]].
